title: Koszul-regular and H_1-regular sequences
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $r\ge0$, $f_1,\dots,f_r\in R$, and $M$ an $R$-module. With the Koszul complex $K_\bullet(f_1,\dots,f_r)$ of [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex], the sequence $f_1,\dots,f_r$ is called (1) *$M$-Koszul-regular* if $H_i(K_\bullet(f_1,\dots,f_r)\otimes_RM)=0$ for all $i\neq0$; (2) *$M$-$H_1$-regular* if $H_1(K_\bullet(f_1,\dots,f_r)\otimes_RM)=0$; (3) *Koszul-regular* if $H_i(K_\bullet(f_1,\dots,f_r))=0$ for all $i\neq0$; (4) *$H_1$-regular* if $H_1(K_\bullet(f_1,\dots,f_r))=0$.
